description: Restore every moving blossom. Click the leaf sheaths to inspect what each living bridge needs; open sheaths stay open. Use the visible bridge control for this interaction at the desired height; the head follows at limited speed. Wake the garden when ready. Inspection remains available while each deliberate control advances pods through a fixed 40 ms transition in changing wind. A fallen pod or incomplete Check garden ends this attempt. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
